newsitem.title: SAUDI ARABIA: Saudi interior minister meets Yemen's president.
newsitem.headline: Saudi interior minister meets Yemen's president.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's Interior Minister Prince Nayef met with Yemen's President Ali Abdullah Saleh on Monday and delivered a letter from the Saudi monarch King Fahd, Yemeni television reported.

The message dealt with issues of mutual concern and ways of enhancing the "brotherly ties" between the two neighbouring countries, the official television said. It did not disclose details of the letter's contents.

Prince Nayef arrived in Yemen earlier on Monday for a one-day official visit, mainly aimed at following up on talks held in August between Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan and Yemeni officials, including discussions on their mutual borders.

Yemen and Saudi Arabia had several minor clashes in a potentially oil- and gas-rich border area before the two sides signed last year a memorandum of understanding to resolve the 60-year-old border dispute.
Prince Sultan's landmark visit appeared to put an end to years of tension and mistrust between the neighbours.

In July, Prince Nayef and his Yemeni counterpart Hussein Mohammad Arab signed a security pact and an agreement to fight drug trafficking. The security pact is part of last year's memorandum of understanding.

Four Saudis, who confessed in April to bombing a U.S.-run military training centre in Riyadh last year killing five Americans and two Indians, said they had smuggled the explosives from Yemen. The four were beheaded in May.
